title: Regularity of finite simultaneous roots along strict normal crossings
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring such that $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Let $t_1,\ldots,t_r\in A$, $r\geq0$, be equations of the pairwise distinct reduced irreducible branches of a strict normal crossings boundary on $X$, with these branches precisely the closed subschemes $V(t_i)$ [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. Let $n\geq1$ be an integer whose image $n\cdot1_A$ is a unit. Then the ring $$C_n=A[x_1,\ldots,x_r]/(x_1^n-t_1,\ldots,x_r^n-t_r),$$ formed using multivariate polynomial rings [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], is a regular Noetherian ring: each prime localization of $C_n$ is a regular local ring. The zero ring and the empty boundary are permitted; when $r=0$, $C_n=A$.

source.place: Expose IX Proposition 2.1 proof, printed p.133, simultaneous parameter-root algebra before invariants. Regularity of the full covering algebra on a regular SNC pair, including the loci where some branch equations are units; the branch-parameter criterion is Stacks Tag 0BIA (etale-lemma-strict-normal-crossings), literature/stacks-project/etale.tex.

proof.text: Derive a bijective component enumeration from the equality of branch-support ranges and pairwise distinctness. Each principal ideal $(t_i)$ is radical because $A/(t_i)$ is reduced; its zero locus is the continuous image of an irreducible component of $H$, so $(t_i)$ is prime. The range of $\operatorname{Spec}(A/(t_i))\to\operatorname{Spec} A$ is that zero locus. Apply [lem-sfb-snc-root-local-presentation] to this enumeration. It gives Noetherianity of $A$ and $C_n$, regular local coefficient strata of the required dimensions at every $p$, and the prime-localization equivalences.

source.place: Tag 0BIA (lemma-strict-normal-crossings), regular-intersection criterion and proof; applied to the full parameter-root presentation of ILO Expose IX Proposition 2.1, printed p.133. The coefficient and quotient localization identifications and affine Noetherianity are those of the original item steps 1, 2 and 7.

proof.text: For a prime $q\subset C_n$ set $p=q\cap A$ and $R=A_p$. Regularity of $R$ follows from the regular stalk of $\operatorname{Spec} A$ and the affine stalk isomorphism. Membership of $t_i/1$ in the maximal ideal of $R$ is equivalent to $t_i\in p$; $n$ stays a unit under $A\to R$. Thus [lem-sfb-transverse-local-root-family-regular] applies with $J=\varnothing$ and $K=I$. Identify its coefficient ring $R/(0)$ with $R$ and its variable type $\{i\in I:i\in\mathrm{univ}\}$ with $I=\operatorname{Fin}(r)$. The induced polynomial-ring equivalence sends each root relation to the corresponding root relation, so $R[x_i:i\in I]/(x_i^n-t_i:i\in I)$ is regular.

source.place: Expose IX Proposition 2.1 proof, printed p.133, full simultaneous parameter-root algebra before invariants. Algebraic calculation made explicit by the original item steps 3--6: monic free bases and simultaneous induction; Stacks Tag 00NU (algebra-lemma-regular-mod-x) at the root and Tag 07PF (more-algebra-lemma-quotient-regular) off the root. ILO leaves this calculation implicit.

proof.text: For the prime $Q$ corresponding to $q$, regularity of $B$ means that $B_Q$ is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme]. The prime-localization isomorphism of [lem-sfb-snc-root-local-presentation] identifies it with $(C_n)_q$. Since $q$ was arbitrary and $C_n$ is Noetherian, $C_n$ is regular. If $A=0$ there are no primes and $C_n=0$. For $r=0$ the empty presentation is $A$ and the local family lemma uses its empty-root case; $n=1$ is allowed by both lemmas.

lean.statement: theorem isRegularRing_snc_finiteRoot (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (hA : IsRegularScheme (Spec (.of A))) (r : ℕ) (t : Fin r → A) (H : (Spec (.of A)).IdealSheafData) (hH : IsStrictNormalCrossingsBoundary H) (hreduced : ∀ i : Fin r, _root_.IsReduced (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A))) (hdistinct : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin r ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ({t i} : Set A))) (hbranches : Set.range (fun i : Fin r ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ({t i} : Set A)) = Set.image (Set.image Subtype.val) (irreducibleComponents (H.support : Set (Spec (.of A))))) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hnunit : IsUnit (n : A)) : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial (Fin r) A ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin r ↦ (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin r) A) ^ n - MvPolynomial.C (t i))))

reviewed_lean.note: Statement matches the node clause by clause: IsRegularScheme for Spec A; IsStrictNormalCrossingsBoundary H; hbranches makes the zero loci of t_i exactly the irreducible components of |H| (same convention as consumer SNCRootLimitNormalCharts); hreduced (A/(t_i) reduced) and hdistinct (injective zero loci) follow from the node and are needed (t=s^2 and k[x,y]/(x^n-y^n) counterexamples); n>0 and n a unit in A; MvPolynomial(Fin r) A modulo (X_i^n - C t_i); conclusion IsRegularRing (Noetherian + regular local at every prime). No added Noetherian, field, nontriviality or universe assumption. Edge cases A=0, r=0, n=1 and unit t_i handled. Item node unchanged except lean; the 3 dependency records are identical to live; lean.statement verbatim; imports are exactly the dependency modules, all checked to exist; existing:false justified.
